_about: The Video page's Camera move and Lens cards (2026-11-03, Mike; docs/tasks/task-camera-lens.md). Every line here is what reaches the model, read by src/camera.py. Moves are written by their relationship to the subject (LTX's own advice, prompts/models/ltx.md 7) and one per clip (Seedance: 'one camera movement per shot', prompts/models/seedance.md 7). Lens words describe what the lens DOES to the picture, never only a number: no video model has a lens setting, and Veo's guide names lens by effect (shallow depth of field, wide-angle, macro, deep focus; prompts/models/veo.md 3). `ltx` is the value LTX 2.5's own camera_motion takes (fal schema, read 2026-11-03). `clip` is the R2 key of Mike's own reference clip of the move; null until he shoots it.

moves.label: Locked off
moves.words: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move.

moves.label: Push in
moves.words: The camera slowly dollies in toward the subject, ending on a medium close-up.

moves.label: Pull out
moves.words: The camera slowly dollies back from the subject, revealing the space around it.

moves.label: Truck left
moves.words: The camera trucks left, moving sideways and staying parallel to the subject.

moves.label: Truck right
moves.words: The camera trucks right, moving sideways and staying parallel to the subject.

moves.label: Crane up
moves.words: The camera cranes up from eye level and rises above the subject, tilting down to keep it in frame.

moves.label: Crane down
moves.words: The camera cranes down from above and settles at the subject's eye level.

moves.label: Rack focus
moves.words: The camera holds still while the focus pulls from the foreground to the subject.

moves.label: Orbit
moves.words: The camera orbits in a smooth half circle around the subject, keeping it centered.

moves.label: Dolly zoom
moves.words: Dolly zoom: the camera dollies in while zooming out, so the subject stays the same size and the background stretches behind it.

moves.label: Whip pan
moves.words: The camera whip pans fast off the subject with strong motion blur.

moves.label: FPV fly-through
moves.words: FPV drone shot: the camera flies fast and low through the space and arrives at the subject.

14.label: 14mm
14.words: ultra-wide-angle view with exaggerated perspective and stretched edges

24.label: 24mm
24.words: wide-angle view that shows the surroundings

50.label: 50mm
50.words: natural perspective, close to how the eye sees

135.label: 135mm
135.words: telephoto compression that pulls the background close

macro.label: Macro
macro.words: macro close-up where fine surface detail fills the frame

f1.4.label: f/1.4
f1.4.words: very shallow depth of field, the background melted into soft bokeh

f2.8.label: f/2.8
f2.8.words: shallow depth of field, the background softly out of focus

f11.label: f/11
f11.words: deep focus, foreground and background both sharp

anamorphic.label: Anamorphic
anamorphic.words: anamorphic lens with horizontal flares and oval bokeh

vintage.label: Vintage glass
vintage.words: vintage lens softness with gentle glow

halation.label: Halation
halation.words: film halation glowing around the highlights

diffusion.label: Diffusion
diffusion.words: soft diffusion filter blooming the highlights

conflicts: Rack focus needs a shallow focus, and f/11 keeps everything sharp.
A dolly zoom needs room to move, and macro is inches from the subject.
_placement_about: Where the camera line goes, by model family, from each vendor's own order: Veo leads with cinematography (veo.md 3, 'Conflicts'), Seedance writes the camera move first inside a shot (seedance.md 6); LTX wants the action first with the camera woven in after (ltx.md 'Order'), Kling puts camera after subject, action and scene (kling.md 3). Unlisted families take the tail.
clip_line: Use {tag} as the camera movement reference only: follow its camera path and speed, and take nothing else from it (not its subject, set, light or look).
